frames.narration: The page starts the price lookup and gets a future back at once. The value is not there yet.
It does not wait. It starts the stock lookup straight away and gets a second future.
Both lookups now run at the same time. The page waits on both futures together.
The stock lookup finishes first. Its promise sets the value and the future completes.
The price arrives, 150 ms after the start. The total wait was about the slowest lookup, not the sum.
Both futures are done, so the continuation combines the two values and the page is shown. If one had failed, its error would be a value too.
